name: CSN 303 防冰坏 微动开关问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 303, now call Guangzhou Control and tell him you’ve just passed 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 China Southern 303，现在呼叫 广州管制，告诉他你刚通过 3600 meters。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, passing 3600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，正在通过 3600 meters。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue climbing to level 4200 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，按 QNH 1014 继续爬升到 4200 meters。
cards.referenceText: Continue climbing to 4200 meters, QNH1014, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升到 4200 meters，QNH1014，CSN303。

cards.audioText: B: You find a gradual ice build-up. You think that might be caused by de-icing equipment failure. Require descent to below the freezing level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你发现逐渐积冰。你认为可能是除冰设备故障造成。要求下降到结冰层以下。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we are getting a gradual ice build-up as a result of suspected deicing equipment failure. We require descent to below the freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们出现逐渐积冰，怀疑由除冰设备故障导致。我们要求下降到结冰层以下。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, descend 3000 meters, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，下降 3000 meters，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters, QNH1014, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 3000 meters，QNH1014，CSN303。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, let me know if you require lower, do emergency conditions exist at the moment?
B: You reply that the current level is ok but the de-ice system still refuses working. The emergency condition is still existing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，如需更低请告诉我，目前是否存在紧急情况？
B: 你回答当前高度可以，但除冰系统仍不工作。紧急情况仍然存在。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, that should be sufficiently low enough, but the de-ice system still refuses working. I mean that emergency conditions do exist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，这个高度应该足够低，但除冰系统仍不工作。我的意思是紧急情况确实存在。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, China Southern 303.
B: Tell the controller you intend to dump fuel for 15 minutes then return to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，China Southern 303。
B: 告诉管制员你打算放油 15 分钟，然后返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we will require a return to the field and an extra 15 minutes en-route for fuel dumping.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们需要返场，并在航路上额外 15 分钟放油。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, understand, turn right heading 330, expect runway 02L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，明白，右转航向 330，预计跑道 02 left。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, expect runway 02L, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，预计跑道 02L，CSN303。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, do you expect your approach and landing to be normal?
B: Give an affirmative reply.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，你预计进近和着陆正常吗？
B: 肯定回答。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，CSN303。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, orbit left from your present position, you may have wide orbits, fuel dumping approved, report on completion.
B: Read-back and tell the controller you’re commencing the fuel dumping.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，从当前位置左盘旋，可以大范围盘旋，批准放油，完成后报告。
B: 复诵并告诉管制员你们正在开始放油。
cards.referenceText: Left hand orbits, we’re commencing the fuel dump this time, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左盘旋，我们现在开始放油，CSN303。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller fuel dumping completed, and request a further clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员放油完成，并请求进一步许可。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN303, we’ve completed the fuel dump and request a further clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN303，我们已完成放油，请求进一步许可。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 303, roger, fly heading 320 and contact Approach on 130.0.
B: Read-back and you are not sure of the Approach frequency. You hear it as 120.0.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: China Southern 303，收到，飞航向 320，联系进近 130.0。
B: 复诵，但你不确定进近频率。你听成了 120.0。
cards.referenceText: Vacating the orbit, flying heading 320, confirm Approach frequency is 120.0, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 脱离盘旋，飞航向 320，请确认进近频率是 120.0，CSN303。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, negative, contact Approach on 130.0.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，否定，联系进近 130.0。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Approach 130.0, CSN303.

cards.audioText: B: Contact Baiyun Approach, tell him you have got information Golf.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系白云进近，告诉他你已收到信息 Golf。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Approach, CSN303, received information Golf.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云进近，CSN303，已收到信息 Golf。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, Approach, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1014, Left pattern runway 02L, 20 miles to run.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，进近，按 QNH 1014 下降到 1200 meters，跑道 02 left 左航线，距接地点 20 miles。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH1014, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH1014 下降到 1200 meters，CSN303。

cards.audioText: B: Report you have a flap extension problem caused by prior icing issue, perhaps a micro-switch malfunction. You will conduct a flapless landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 报告你因先前积冰问题出现襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障。你将进行无襟翼着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Baiyun Approach, CSN303, we have a flap extension due to prior icing issue; perhaps a micro-switch malfunction, request flapless landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，白云进近，CSN303，由于先前积冰问题，我们有襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障，请求无襟翼着陆。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, change of runway 02R, which is 200 meters longer. Turn right heading 200 for downwind, now with 10 miles to touchdown, maintain 1200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，改用跑道 02 right，该跑道长 200 meters。右转航向 200 加入下风边，现在距接地点 10 miles，保持 1200 meters。
cards.referenceText: Runway 02 right, right turn, heading 200 and maintain 1200 meters, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02 right，右转，航向 200，保持 1200 meters，CSN303。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, contact Baiyun Tower on 118.1. We have notified your condition to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，联系白云塔台118.1。我们已将你的情况通知塔台。

cards.audioText: B: Now, contact Baiyun Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云塔台。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Tower, CSN303, maintain 1200m, left downwind for runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云塔台，CSN303，保持 1200m，跑道 02R 左下风。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue descent to 900 meters on QNH, you are NO.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，收到，按 QNH 继续下降到 900 meters，你是 1 号。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900m on QNH, NO.1, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900m，按 QNH，1 号，CSN303。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 303, extend downwind as you wish, turn left at your own discretion to join base. Mind your speed!
cards.audioTextZh: C: China Southern 303，按你的需要延长下风边，自行决定左转加入基线。注意速度！
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN303。
